newsitem.title: USA: Avis files for initial public stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Avis files for initial public stock offering.

text.p: Avis Rent A Car Inc, a unit of HFS Inc, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of up to $250 million of common stock.
Avis has applied to the New York Stock Exchange to trade under the stock symbol "AVI".
Avis did not provide details as to amount of stock being offering, the estimated initial price, or the total outstanding after the offer.
The offer will be made through Bear, Stearns & Co Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including future acquisitions, Avis said.
Upon consummation of the offering, HFS will be the beneficial owner of about 25 percent of the outstanding Avis shares. HFS said it has no current plans to reduce its ownership, according the filing.
Avis, based in Garden City, N.J., is a general used car rental business.
